statements.t: Management expects the Company’s short-term liquidity requirements over the twelve months following the filing of this Quarterly Report to be funded primarily through collections of patient accounts receivable, rent receivable and other receivables, mortgage refinancing activity, including the potential refinancing of the Southland facility, additional debt borrowings and proceeds from the sale of assets…
The Company anticipates completing the sale before December 31, 2026, subject to execution of a definitive purchase agreement, due diligence, financing, and customary closing conditions.
The Company anticipates collecting a portion of past due rent subsequent to quarter end and is negotiating various methods to collect the remaining unpaid rent and notes receivable.

The Company anticipates net principal repayments of approximately $7.9 million during the next twelve-month period, consisting of approximately $4.0 million of routine debt service amortization, $0.2 million of bond debt payments, and $3.7 million of Southland's maturing debt.
Management expects the Company’s long-term liquidity needs will be funded primarily from cash generated in the ordinary course of business in conjunction with the sale of securities.
